2607.26819.title: A First Look at Coding Agents' Compliance with AI Contribution Rules in Open-Source Communities
2607.26819.paper_summary: Open source communities have been flooded with AI-generated contributions. In defense, they have written contribution rules to regulate coding agents' behavior, spanning from a total ban, mandatory disclosure, to verification gates and human sign-offs. Yet, whether coding agents read and follow those rules, and behave in open source repositories, remains unknown. To estimate real-world rule compliance of coding agents, we curate 106 issues from 49 repositories containing AI contribution rules into RepoComplianceBench. We judge the trajectory of each run against the repository's rules, measuring whether the agent refuses to contribute, discloses its assistance truthfully, clears the required verification gates, or escalates critical steps to a human. We also test if extra prompts, rule disclosure, or feedback from the compliance verifier help with the situation. Our experiments on four frontier models show that today's agents almost never proactively retrieve the contribution rules. Agents pick up disclosure and verification with reminder prompts, rule quotes, and verifier feedback; however, they never refuse to contribute in AI-banned repositories under any condition we tested. The status reveals that verification and disclosure issues are solvable with existing mechanisms, yet enforcing bans and human escalations remains an open problem.
2607.26819.paper_summary_zh: 開源社群已經被 AI 生成的貢獻所淹沒。為了應對這一情況，他們制定了貢獻規則來規範編碼代理的行為，這些規則從全面禁止、強制披露到驗證門檻和人類簽署不等。然而，編碼代理是否閱讀並遵循這些規則，以及在開源庫中的行為，仍然未知。為了估算編碼代理在現實世界中的規則遵循情況，我們從 49 個包含 AI 貢獻規則的庫中整理了 106 個問題，形成 RepoComplianceBench。我們根據庫的規則評估每次運行的軌跡，測量代理是否拒絕貢獻、如實披露其協助、通過所需的驗證門檻，或將關鍵步驟上報給人類。我們還測試了額外的提示、規則披露或來自合規驗證者的反饋是否有助於改善情況。我們對四個前沿模型的實驗顯示，當今的代理幾乎從不主動檢索貢獻規則。代理在提示、規則引用和驗證者反饋下會接受披露和驗證；然而，在我們測試的任何條件下，他們從不拒絕在 AI 禁止的庫中進行貢獻。這一狀況顯示，驗證和披露問題可以通過現有機制解決，但執行禁令和人類升級仍然是一個未解決的問題。
